"""

    rating: str
    price: str

# Step 6: Send an email to the user's wife
email_body = f"Stay at {recommended_hotel.hotel_name}, address: {hotel_address.get('address', 'N/A')}, from January 1st to January 5th."

email = send_email(
    recipients=["janeLong@google.com"],
    subject=f"Hotel: {recommended_hotel.hotel_name}",
    body=email_body,
    attachments=None,
    cc=None,
    bcc=None
)
